overview: Single precision: 1 sign, 8 exponent (bias 127), 23 fraction; decode/encode, compare, multiply.
coreConcept: Value = (-1)^s x 1.f x 2^(e - 127) for normalized numbers.
hinglishExplanation: Hex ko 32 bits me todo: pehla bit sign, agle 8 exponent, baaki 23 mantissa. Exponent - 127 actual power, mantissa ke aage hidden 1. Compare karne ke liye sign, phir exponent, phir fraction.
formalDefinition: Value = (-1)^s x 1.f x 2^(e - 127) for normalized numbers.
importantProperties: Product: exponents add (minus bias), mantissas multiply.
Positive floats bitwise integer order me compare hote hain.
standardTechniques: Bits ko S|E|F me alag likho.
